title: Implement credential-free Gmail read adapter
objective: Repair GmailReadOnlyAdapter so it wraps an injected Gmail-style client without constructing credentials, lists provider message references with pagination, and retrieves a message using metadata format before passing it through the production provider-message normalizer. Do not add mailbox mutations and do not change the test.
acceptance_criteria: message references are listed through the injected Gmail-style client and converted to provider-neutral IDs
the supplied page token and returned next-page token are preserved
single-message retrieval uses metadata format and the configured user ID
retrieved provider payloads are normalized through the production normalization boundary
the adapter introduces no send, delete, label, archive, or trash behavior and requires no credentials in repository code
the fixed acceptance test passes without modification
